details.task_prompt: Create src/email_validator.py with exactly one public function validate_email(address). It must return True for a plausible email (one '@' with non-empty local and domain parts and a dot in the domain), return False for any invalid string, raise TypeError when address is not a string, and carry a short docstring. Keep the module under 30 lines: no classes, no CLI, no examples. Then create tests/test_email_validator.py with four pytest tests (valid address, invalid string, non-string raises TypeError, missing '@'). Every test must pass when run with pytest. Do not modify unrelated files.
